001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.systemlogger;
002
003import java.time.Instant;
004import java.util.Objects;
005import java.util.ResourceBundle;
006import java.util.function.Supplier;
007
008import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMessageFormatter.StandardMessageFormatter;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter;
014
015/**
016 * Rainbow Gum System Logger implementation. As noted in the module doc this can be used
017 * by others without worry of it registering a {@link System.LoggerFinder}.
018 *
019 * @apiNote This class is final and cannot be extended. If you think it would be useful to
020 * extend file an issue.
021 */
022public final class RainbowGumSystemLogger implements System.Logger {
023
024        private final String loggerName;
025
026        private final LogRouter router;
027
028        /**
029         * Provides a system logger that will use the given root router.
030         * @param loggerName standard dotted logger name.
031         * @param router root router usually the global.
032         * @return un-cached system logger.
033         */
034        public static RainbowGumSystemLogger of(String loggerName, LogRouter router) {
035                return new RainbowGumSystemLogger(loggerName, router);
036        }
037
038        RainbowGumSystemLogger(String loggerName, LogRouter router) {
039                super();
040                this.loggerName = loggerName;
041                this.router = router;
042        }
043
044        private final static Level fixLevel(Level level) {
045                if (level == Level.ALL) {
046                        return Level.TRACE;
047                }
048                return level;
049        }
050
051        @Override
052        public String getName() {
053                return this.loggerName;
054        }
055
056        @Override
057        public boolean isLoggable(Level level) {
058                return router.route(loggerName, fixLevel(level)).isEnabled();
059        }
060
061        @Override
062        public void log(Level level, @Nullable String msg) {
063                this._log(level, msg, (Throwable) null);
064        }
065
066        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
067        @Override
068        public void log(Level level, Supplier<@Nullable String> msgSupplier) {
069                this._log(level, msgSupplier, (Throwable) null);
070        }
071
072        @Override
073        public void log(Level level, Object obj) {
074                Objects.requireNonNull(obj, "obj");
075                level = fixLevel(level);
076                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
077                if (route.isEnabled()) {
078                        String formattedMessage = obj == null ? "" : obj.toString();
079                        LogEvent event = LogEvent.of(level, loggerName, formattedMessage, null);
080                        route.log(event);
081                }
082        }
083
084        @Override
085        public void log(Level level, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
086                this._log(level, msg, throwable);
087        }
088
089        // To keep call depth consistent
090        private void _log(Level level, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
091                level = fixLevel(level);
092                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
093                if (route.isEnabled()) {
094                        LogEvent event = LogEvent.of(level, loggerName, msg, throwable);
095                        route.log(event);
096                }
097        }
098
099        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
100        @Override
101        public void log(Level level, Supplier<@Nullable String> msgSupplier, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
102                this._log(level, msgSupplier, throwable);
103        }
104
105        // To keep call depth consistent
106        private void _log(Level level, Supplier<@Nullable String> msgSupplier, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
107                level = fixLevel(level);
108                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
109                if (route.isEnabled()) {
110                        String formattedMessage = msgSupplier.get();
111                        LogEvent event = LogEvent.of(level, loggerName, formattedMessage, throwable);
112                        route.log(event);
113                }
114        }
115
116        @Override
117        public void log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
118                _log(level, bundle, msg, throwable);
119        }
120
121        private void _log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String msg,
122                        @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
123                level = fixLevel(level);
124                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
125                if (route.isEnabled()) {
126                        String formattedMessage = LevelSystemLogger.getMessage(bundle, msg);
127                        LogEvent event = LogEvent.of(level, loggerName, formattedMessage, throwable);
128                        route.log(event);
129                }
130        }
131
132        @Override
133        public void log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String format, @Nullable Object... args) {
134                this._log(level, bundle, format, args);
135        }
136
137        // To keep call depth consistent.
138        private void _log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String format, @Nullable Object... args) {
139                level = fixLevel(level);
140                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
141                if (route.isEnabled()) {
142                        Instant timestamp = Instant.now();
143                        String threadName = Thread.currentThread().getName();
144                        long threadId = Thread.currentThread().threadId();
145                        String message = LevelSystemLogger.getMessage(bundle, format);
146                        Throwable throwable = null;
147                        LogEvent event = LogEvent.ofAll(timestamp, threadName, threadId, level, loggerName, message, KeyValues.of(),
148                                        throwable, StandardMessageFormatter.JUL, args);
149                        route.log(event);
150                }
151        }
152
153}
